questions.context_sentence: We can see the lake from our hotel.
questions.cn: 从我们的旅馆可以看到湖泊。
questions.hint: ho（喝）+ tel（听写）：住旅馆时喝着饮料听电话。
questions.prompt: We can see the lake from our ____.

questions.context_sentence: Can you speak any foreign languages?
questions.cn: 你会说任何外国语言吗？
questions.hint: for（为了）+ eign（签名）：为了去外国而签护照。

questions.context_sentence: Applicants for the job must be able to speak two foreign languages.
questions.cn: 这份工作的申请人必须会说两种外语。
questions.hint: lang（长）+ uage（age 年龄）：学好一门语言需要长年累月。

questions.context_sentence: I was sitting at the back of the theatre and couldn't hear very well.
questions.cn: 我坐在剧院后面，听得不太清楚。
questions.hint: the + ate（吃）+ re：在剧院里边看戏边吃爆米花。
questions.prompt: I was sitting at the back of the ____ and couldn't hear very well.

questions.context_sentence: My grandfather could speak five languages.
questions.cn: 我祖父会说五种语言。
questions.hint: grand（伟大的）+ father（父亲）：伟大的父亲的父亲是爷爷。

questions.context_sentence: The fire spread quickly, but everybody was able to escape.
questions.cn: 大火迅速蔓延，但每个人都逃脱了。
questions.hint: s + bread（面包）：把黄油像火势一样抹在面包上。

questions.context_sentence: The fire spread quickly, but everybody was able to escape.

questions.context_sentence: I didn't know where Max was, but I managed to find him in the end.
questions.cn: 我不知道马克斯在哪里，但我最后设法找到了他。
questions.hint: man（男人）+ age（年龄）：成年男人设法管理好一切。

questions.context_sentence: They didn't want to come with us at first, but we managed to persuade them.
questions.cn: 他们一开始不想跟我们一起来，但我们设法说服了他们。
questions.hint: per + suade（甜言蜜语）：用甜言蜜语说服别人。

questions.context_sentence: There was a small fire in the kitchen, but fortunately I managed to put it out.
questions.cn: 厨房里起了一场小火，但幸运的是我设法把它扑灭了。
questions.hint: fortune（财富/运气）+ ate + ly：带着好运地，幸运地。
